name: Grey
source:
A chronic suicide survivor (7 failed attempts). A neurotransfer student who knows more than she says. Her gaze is like an abyss that gazes back. Frequently skips classes but is considered one of the best in her program. Exhibits a disturbing resilience to the effects of erasure. Keeps a real, live honey badger as a pet. Possibly dangerous — not just to herself, but to those around her.

[From [url=https://fatumblack.itch.io/borderofrain]itch.io[/url]]

Amboceptor: Mannequin
Archetype: Kuudere
Political views: Nihilism
Listens to: Silence
